- Overestimate prices after recent spikes; model tends to overshoot and fail to correct downward quickly.  
- Underestimate prices when sentiment is strongly negative (sentiment < 0.3) — model reacts too slowly to bearish signals.  
- Overreact to short-term sentiment swings; model often follows sentiment too closely, leading to overcorrection or undercorrection in subsequent periods.  
- Mean reversion bias: model frequently fails to revert to historical mean after sharp moves, especially in the 10–15 day horizon.  
- Lagged response to sentiment: model delays reaction to sentiment shifts, particularly when sentiment turns negative mid-period.  
- Avoid overconfidence in 30-day forecasts — model often overestimates near-term price stability, ignoring volatility clustering.
